rule_title: Outstanding performance deficits remain active targets

input_contract.$comment: Structural inputs taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §14.5. Records the capacity-to-demand-gap continuation structure only; no targets, thresholds, or plans invented.

decision_contract.$comment: Outstanding-performance-deficit continuation structure only. While the capacity-to-demand gap remains open, outstanding performance/workload/robustness deficits remain active Resilience targets; symptom resolution does not end rehabilitation. Deficits are not converted into automatic RTS denial (no closed safety state assigned by source) and the gap is not closed without evidence. No targets/plan/dosage/exercise selection/progression/RTT/RTS created. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Architecture normative source; normative strength MUST; permitted_use logic_with_uncertainty.
